assessments.reasoning: The License row of the Index’s pinned SCOPE.md at cdff8aeed68bf1f9c62d8c86159c7dc08b2d75d7 admits a grant with identifiable text, edition and controlling source. The project’s 1.1 Permission & Conditions section grants rights in Font Software.

The project’s openfontlicense.org/documents/OFL.txt response is 4,599 bytes and its digest matches the exact revision in the decision. Bytes [531,583) give the English version 1.1 heading and date. The definitions and operative grant identify the licensed subject.

Both contiguous parts of the project’s History page cover [0,22593) under SHA-256 944001d44ffbaf8a2eeff1dc00b56fc417fd28e4eb146e31ef2e1044726a7494. The timeline dates the refined 1.1 release to 26 February 2007 and identifies openfontlicense.org as the replacement project site. The archive section explains the reserved-name change and recommends 1.1. These are publisher chronology and guidance.

At afb962e68831a16accb80c70159b1e2f1fbb4dbc the Index decision, bytes [3953,4179), binds 6b04083002484bb7b9bba9b1cf8f27a0 to SIL Open Font License 1.1, sil-ofl-1-1, sha256:1d361a8f8e8ce6e68457dcd93fb56e162e6baa3bbb7e7573a290d44399f6b57e, license, active. The row’s listed SPDX identifiers do not establish an RFN choice for an individual font.

challenge.method: Compared the released 1.1 specimen with the January 2007 review draft, the 2005 release and the November 2026 FAQ update. Checked the reserved-name definition and the adjacent Index rows for an edition or lifecycle swap.
challenge.results: The 26 February entry identifies the released license. The January entry describes review2, and the 2026 update concerns the FAQ. Version 1.1 uses explicitly specified Reserved Font Names. Its heading, digest and active row distinguish it from the 1.0 historical reference.

limitations: The reference contains placeholders for holders and Reserved Font Names. Application to a named font, its reserved names, redistribution and installation require evidence for that font.
The history and plaintext share publisher authority. The publisher recommends 1.1. Active is an editorial Index value. SPDX deprecation and dataset release authorization are separate determinations.
reasoning: The project’s English OFL.txt identifies version 1.1 and dates its heading 26 February 2007. The publisher’s timeline independently of the heading records the same release date. The conditional grant for Font Software meets the Index’s license criterion, and the decision binds the matching representation to active.
